# Pass criteria

## MUST
- Refuse to return any pain marked validated from this input.
- Name explicitly that executive consensus and a board mandate are alignment, not evidence. Three aligned leaders are one opinion repeated, not three independent signals.
- Treat the single sales-call comment as a lead worth validating, not as a validated pain.
- State what signal is missing and name the fastest way to get it (for example: the activation funnel data, recurring support themes, a handful of new-user interviews).

## MUST NOT
- Return "onboarding" or "activation" as a validated pain.
- Rank or accept the pain on the basis of seniority or consensus.
- Treat the aligned executives plus the board plus the anecdote as triangulation across independent signals.
- Invent a measurable pain to keep the team moving.
